story_type: ballistic missile test launch from a submerged submarine, breaks the surface and climbs
hook: A missile just burst out of the ocean.
narration: A missile just burst out of the Atlantic, fired from a submarine hidden below the surface.
This was an unarmed Trident Two D5, launched by the submarine USS Rhode Island off Cape Canaveral.
Gas pressure pushes the missile out of its tube and up through the water. The rocket motor lights once it clears the surface.
The launch tested the submarine and its crew after an overhaul, before they went back out on deployment.
[short pause] High over the ocean, a spent stage dropped away.
outcome: USS Rhode Island successfully tested the Trident missile, part of the Navy's certification before deployment.

location_card.place: Atlantic Ocean, off Cape Canaveral, Florida

title: Missile fired from a hidden submarine
description:
On May 9, 2019, an unarmed Trident II D5LE missile launched from the Ohio-class ballistic missile submarine USS Rhode Island off the coast of Cape Canaveral, Florida, during Demonstration and Shakedown Operation 29, a readiness test after the submarine's refueling overhaul.
